Level 5 · Governance and Evolution

Level 5: Architecture Governance and Evolution

Keep architecture healthy across many teams and many years: guardrails teams accept, migrations that finish and dependencies you can leave.

See pathways

Planned: outline published, course not built

Who it is for
Lead engineers, platform owners and architects responsible for more than one team or system.
Before you start
Level 4, Agentic AI Architecture, or equivalent experience across more than one system.
Capstone evidence
One governance pack: principles, checks, migration plan, dependency exits and compliance evidence.
How it is assessed
Planned: quiz questions, a governance lab and a moderated review. Not available yet.

Modules and evidence

Each module ends in an artefact that goes into your record.

ModuleWhat it coversEvidence
Governance that teams acceptLight rules, automated where possible.Principles, guardrails, a review process that does not block, and health measures
Evolving systemsChange without stopping the business.A migration plan with a way back at each step, and a dependency assessment with an exit
Risk and complianceEvidence an auditor can follow.A risk register and compliance mapping with audit evidence
